phase: METADATA_ONLY_CANDIDATE_FREEZE; response values not admitted by this script
scope: Retrospective exposed published ComBat-corrected assay-repeat ranking stability; no model fit, Agent comparison or mechanism attribution

endpoint.response: Published replicate-level log2-fold-change relative to DMSO; lower is preferred

selection.order: Archive evaluation commit order, then left rank, then right rank; stable ascending prior prediction within frozen terminal menu
selection.next10_status: Derived now from the archived pre-terminal-scoring full prediction array; ranks11-20 were not historically registered top20 commitments
selection.alias_rule: Retain original conservative metadata alias groups and exact representative column/full Broad drug-batch ID; no new equivalence, name, prefix, salt or fuzzy substitution
selection.context_filter: Exact archived row_name=depmap_id=context, passing primary/secondary STR and unique exact HTS002 pool mapping; excluded contexts retained

pairing.expected_repeats: All identical actual detection-plate IDs shared by both exact drugs on the same compound plate in FULL treatment metadata; lexically ordered for storage only
pairing.eligibility: Unique condition/plate mappings, each drug's well consistent across repeats, at least2 common recorded and header-accessible repeats; eligible is metadata-only
pairing.header_absence: Retain expected detection plate and exact column; runner must assign absent-header outcome NA without replacing it
pairing.excluded_case_access: Ineligible cases expose no top-level repeat_columns; full candidate mappings and exclusions remain in blocks without admitting their outcomes
pairing.finite_complete_rule: Requires finite contrasts for ALL expected metadata repeats; partial finite coverage must be reported separately
pairing.independence: Pairs reuse drugs/plates; contexts share pools; all corrected repeats share condition-wise ComBat. Counts are descriptive units, not independent biological n

outcome_access.availability_warning: Metadata/header presence is not finite outcome availability or a raw-QC certificate

publisher_assumptions.assay_repeats: Original methods support up to3 independently treated plates,1-3 after QC
publisher_assumptions.processed_QC: Published outlier-pool and control-separation filtering; not independently reconstructed
publisher_assumptions.ComBat: Joint condition-specific correction across cell-line pool/replicate batches; released repeats do not provide an independent raw-preprocessing holdout
publisher_assumptions.MTS010: Technical redos logged separately and excluded, despite publisher downstream-use recommendation
